svg.text: Control K128: representative physical two-slot N-loop
SE0 CU2 SIMD1; slot 0 N11; absolute cycles [1872740, 1879312); 6572 cycles; MFMA busy 73.04%
Selected from 1079 complete windows: busy within 0.1 percentage point of 73.08%, then duration nearest the 6880-cycle median. ATT issue = first_attempt + stall.
Anchor slot 0 logical N-block recipe (counts validated against this ATT window)
16 x LDS write -> wait -> 8 x LDS read
8 x VMEM store; next N waits for accumulator retirement
Actual ATT timeline (4-cycle ticks; colored runs preserve observed timing)
Any-slot MFMA execution: 4,800 / 6,572 cycles = 73.04%. Idle colors use the same conservative two-wave classifier as the overview.
Reading rule: a wave can issue VMEM/LDS/VALU while an earlier MFMA remains in its 16-cycle execution window, so the MFMA and ATT-event rows are intentionally separate.
An idle physical segment means neither resident slot executes MFMA. Its color describes the observed two-wave blockers; it is not a claim that every colored cycle is locally removable.
The anchor excludes N0/N1 and the final two N blocks; both wave files cover the full window with no slot replacement, prologue, drain, or incomplete stitching.
